name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: Above Ratchet, Strahad Farsan sends an Alliance warlock to Ironforge. There, the Tome of the Cabal may hold what an unprepared summoner needs to bind a felhunter.

sections.title: A Beast That Feeds on Magic
sections.body: An imp, a voidwalker, or a succubus may be subdued by ritual. A felhunter is another matter. It serves the Burning Legion and hunts arcane energy to devour. A common summoning circle crumbles before it can hold the demon. The felhunter drains its summoner’s magic before any binding takes hold. From his redoubt in the Barrens, Strahad Farsan watches over Ratchet. He knows no amateur should attempt the binding unprepared.

sections.title: The First Binding
sections.body: An acolyte needs the Tome of the Cabal’s arcane formulas to summon and bind a felhunter safely. The manuscript was written by the first mortal cabal of warlocks to break one without outside aid. Its pages explain the geomancy, materials, and binding runes needed to withstand the creature’s hunger. The copy was lost long ago. Strahad and his circle no longer have the masterwork.

sections.title: The Hoarder of Dun Morogh
sections.body: Strahad cannot provide the text, so he sends Alliance warlocks across the Great Sea to the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. Krom Stoutarm, an itinerant dwarven warlock, resides there. In his twilight years, he combs through ancient manuscripts and library records. If any trace of the lost grimoire remains recorded in the Eastern Kingdoms, it lies in Krom’s meticulous catalogs.

faq.q: Why do I need to find the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal holds precise instructions from the first mortal warlocks to summon and subdue a felhunter without outside aid. Ordinary summoning rites cannot trap a demon that feeds on magical energy.
Krom Stoutarm is a wandering dwarven warlock who resides in the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He spends his days among dusty tomes, cataloguing ancient historical records.

faq.q: Why is Strahad Farsan in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an accomplished human warlock with a quiet, neutral redoubt on the bluffs above Ratchet. Away from the watchful eyes of the Kirin Tor and Stormwind’s authorities, he trains both Alliance and Horde practitioners in powerful demonology.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Krom Stoutarm?
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm recalls references to the tome in old cataloguing registers. He sends you to track down its lost parts and recover the rare reagents needed to restore the grimoire.

faq.q: Can Horde warlocks do this quest?
faq.answer: This journey to Ironforge is for Alliance warlocks. Strahad sends Horde warlocks to find knowledgeable contacts within Horde territory.

faq.q: What demon does this questline unlock?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal chain ends in ritual combat against a summoned felhunter. The warlock learns to summon and bind one as a permanent minion.

angles.text: As a warlock, obtaining the Tome of the Cabal marks a step toward mastery over felhunters. It takes you beyond lesser servants and into anti-magic demonology.
As an Alliance practitioner, you cross back from Kalimdor’s frontier to the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge, seeking illicit dark texts.
As a dwarf, you see that not everyone in the Hall of Explorers digs up Titan artifacts. Krom Stoutarm privately compiles demonic lore.
